title: Sections with closed support, all four clauses, for arbitrary condensed coefficients.
statement:
Fix the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\Lambda$ be any unital condensed ring, without a commutativity hypothesis [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For each scheme $T$ put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and $\mathcal M_T=\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T}(\operatorname{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\operatorname{Ab}))$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion with complementary quasi-compact open immersion $j:V\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use the abelian sheaf inverse/direct images [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], lifted to module actions [sk-def-sfb-transport] and identified with $\Lambda_T$ using $\alpha_f:f^{-1}\Lambda_S\cong\Lambda_T$ [def-sfb-alpha, lem-sfb-alpha-iso]. In particular $f^*$ applies abelian inverse image and then restricts scalars along $\alpha_f^{-1}$, and $f_*$ uses the adjoint coefficient map. Write $\eta^f:1\to f_*f^*$ for their specified module adjunction unit.

Define $N(M)=\ker(\eta^j_M)$ in $\mathcal M_X$, with inclusion $\kappa_M:N(M)\to M$ and kernel maps on morphisms [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $\Gamma_Z=i^*N$. Let $\theta:N\to i_*\Gamma_Z$ be the actual closed unit $\eta^i$ evaluated on $N$. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(\mathcal M_T)$, assumed to exist in the chosen universes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and total right derived functors with their canonical comparison units [def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. A complex is K-injective when every chain map from an acyclic complex into it is chain homotopic to zero. Then:

1. $\theta$ is invertible and $\Gamma_Z$ preserves finite limits. There exists a sheaf adjunction $a:i_*\dashv\Gamma_Z$ with counit $\epsilon^a$ satisfying $\epsilon^a_M\circ\theta_M=\kappa_M$ for every $M$.
2. For every injective $I\in\mathcal M_X$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], $\eta^j_I:I\to j_*j^*I$ is an epimorphism. Termwise $\Gamma_Z$ preserves K-injective complexes, and its right-derived comparison is invertible on every K-injective complex, not only those with injective terms.
3. For all complexes $A$ of $\mathcal M_Z$ and K-injective complexes $I$ of $\mathcal M_X$, there is an isomorphism of global abelian-group-valued complexes
$$e:\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}_X(i_*A,I)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}_Z(A,\Gamma_ZI).$$
Here $\operatorname{Hom}^n(C,D)=\prod_{p\in\mathbf Z}\operatorname{Hom}(C^p,D^{p+n})$ with $df=d_Df-(-1)^nf d_C$, and $e(f)_{p,q}=a.\operatorname{homEquiv}_{A^p,I^q}(f_{p,q})$ whenever $q=p+n$.
4. The additive functor $i_*$ preserves finite colimits. With this exact structure there are adjunctions $b:D(i_*)\dashv R\Gamma_Z$ and $c:D(j^*)\dashv Rj_*$ obtained by deriving exactly $a$ and the specified $j^*\dashv j_*$, respectively. There is a natural transformation $\delta:Rj_*D(j^*)\to D(i_*)R\Gamma_Z[1]$ for which
$$D(i_*)R\Gamma_ZK\xrightarrow{\epsilon^b_K}K\xrightarrow{\eta^c_K}Rj_*D(j^*)K\xrightarrow{\delta_K}D(i_*)R\Gamma_ZK[1]$$
is distinguished for every $K$. For every distinguished triangle $F\xrightarrow{s}K\xrightarrow{\eta^c_K}Rj_*D(j^*)K\xrightarrow{t}F[1]$, there exists an isomorphism $R\Gamma_ZK\cong D(i^*)F$; no cone object or functorial choice of such an isomorphism is stipulated.

proof.text: Repeat the proved generic recollement argument of closedSupport_triangle with arbitrary chosen HasDerivedCategory universe w. Lift full faithfulness of closed and open direct image to derived categories. Exact open restriction kills the closed image. The abelian supported-unit assertion gives joint zero detection on cohomology, hence joint zero detection on derived categories. The cone of the closed unit vanishes when open restriction vanishes, identifying the open kernel with the closed essential image. Recollement.existsUnique_distTriang_counit_unit gives the boundary; Recollement.exists_triangleHom gives its naturality.

Apply exact closed inverse image and the invertible derived closed counit to obtain the requested fibre isomorphism.

theorem formal_closed_support_adjunction
    {X Z V : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : V ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (hij : Set.range j = (Set.range i)ᶜ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (FormalSupportModules Λ X)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (FormalSupportModules Λ Z)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (FormalSupportModules Λ V)] :
    IsIso (formalSupportKernelComparison Λ i j) ∧
    PreservesFiniteLimits (formalClosedSupport Λ i j) ∧
    ∃ a : lowerStar Λ i ⊣ formalClosedSupport Λ i j,
      (∀ M : FormalSupportModules Λ X,
        (formalSupportKernelComparison Λ i j).app M ≫ a.counit.app M =
          (formalSupportKernelInclusion Λ j).app M) ∧
      (∀ (I : FormalSupportModules Λ X) [Injective I],
        Epi ((formalSupportPullbackAdjunction Λ j).unit.app I)) ∧
      (∀ (I : CochainComplex (FormalSupportModules Λ X) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective],
        CochainComplex.IsKInjective
          (((formalClosedSupport Λ i j).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)) ∧
      (∀ (I : CochainComplex (FormalSupportModules Λ X) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective],
        IsIso ((formalClosedSupport Λ i j).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I))) ∧
      (∀ (A : CochainComplex (FormalSupportModules Λ Z) ℤ)
        (I : CochainComplex (FormalSupportModules Λ X) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective],
        ∃ e : CochainComplex.HomComplex
            (((lowerStar Λ i).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj A) I ≅
          CochainComplex.HomComplex A
            (((formalClosedSupport Λ i j).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I),
          ∀ (n : ℤ) (f : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain
            (((lowerStar Λ i).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj A) I n)
            (p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + n = q),
            (((e.hom.f n).hom f).v p q hpq) =
              a.homEquiv (A.X p) (I.X q) (f.v p q hpq)) ∧
      Exists fun [hclosed : PreservesFiniteColimits (lowerStar Λ i)] ↦
        ∃ (b : (lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory ⊣
            (formalClosedSupport Λ i j).rightDerivedFunctor)
          (c : (formalSupportPullback Λ j).mapDerivedCategory ⊣
            (lowerStar Λ j).rightDerivedFunctor),
          ∃ δ : (formalSupportPullback Λ j).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
              (lowerStar Λ j).rightDerivedFunctor ⟶
            (formalClosedSupport Λ i j).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
              (lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
                shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (FormalSupportModules Λ X)) (1 : ℤ),
            b = a.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction ∧
            c = (formalSupportPullbackAdjunction Λ j).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction ∧
            (∀ K : DerivedCategory (FormalSupportModules Λ X),
              Triangle.mk (b.counit.app K) (c.unit.app K) (δ.app K) ∈ distTriang _) ∧
            (∀ (K F : DerivedCategory (FormalSupportModules Λ X)) (s : F ⟶ K)
              (t : (lowerStar Λ j).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
                ((formalSupportPullback Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ⟶ F⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
              Triangle.mk s (c.unit.app K) t ∈ distTriang _ →
              Nonempty ((formalClosedSupport Λ i j).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K ≅
                (formalSupportPullback Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj F)) := by
  sorry
